text:
incident-bot: HIGH SEV: spike detected - gateway_5xx_rate(us-west-2) = 3.8% (5m) - affected route: /v1/generate - paging oncall priya
priya: on it. taking pager. quick check: customer impact? any big customers flagged?
carlos: Support: multiple customers reporting timeouts and 502s since ~22:12 UTC. one SLA alert triggered. sending sample trace ids.
jamal: looking at metrics now — 502s and 504s correlate with increased upstream latency from provider 'edgex' in us-west-2. p95 latency jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s.
alex: sounds like upstream provider partial outage. Recommend temporary traffic split to other region + enable short-circuit fallback to smaller model variant to reduce token latency.
sofia: starting failover playbook: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/failover - will flip routing flag. priya, want me to run the change?
priya: please do. execute safe rollback steps too. post the command here when you run it.
sofia: running: ```curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/route/split" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","split":{"us-west-2":30,"us-east-1":70}}'```
infra-bot: action accepted. routing split job queued (job id: job_2026_3101). will apply after 10s cooldown.
sofia: applied. verifying traffic shift... initial traffic now 68% us-east, 32% us-west. p50 latency on /v1/generate dropped ~40% in us-east.
jamal: good. suppressing immediate noisy 5xx alerts — will add 10m cooldown and require sustained 2min > 2% to fire. draft alert rule: ```- alert: Gateway5xxSustained
  expr: increase(gateway_5xx_count[2m]) / increase(request_count[2m]) > 0.02
  for: 10m
  labels: {severity: page}```
priya: ok to mute pager for flapping while we stabilize, keep high-severity channel notifications though.
morgan: created a temporary dashboard panel: Metrics -> upstream_latency_ms (p50/p95), gateway_5xx_rate, 502_by_provider. Link: https://metrics.redwood/d/ux123/upstream-health (shared)
jamal: also adding a short-term filter to hide provider-specific 502s in high-traffic windows to reduce noise in infra alerts; we'll revisit after incident.
carlos: continuing to collect affected customer trace ids, sending to provider support with request for root cause and ETA. ticket #EXT-4567 created.
priya: we should also throttle retry behavior client-side for a bit to avoid amplifying upstream failures. alex, can you push a small release to adjust retry policy?
alex: pushing a hotfix to change retries from 3 -> 1 for external provider calls and add exponential backoff. deploying now. ```git rev: hotfix/retries-3101 -> deploy```
infra-bot: deploy started job_id=deploy_3101, targeting canary 5% then 50% -> 100%.
sofia: canaries look good, errors trending down in us-west after routing + retry changes. p95 latency reduced from 1.2s -> 380ms.
jamal: fine-tuning alert thresholds: propose creating a derived metric `upstream_degraded{provider="edgeX"}` and alert when p95 > 800ms for 15m. will add to next change window.
priya: good. immediate action items: 1) keep routing split until provider confirms fix, 2) merge retry hotfix, 3) suppress alert flapping as jamal suggested, 4) open post-incident for thresholds/dashboard work. Assign owners?
sofia: I'll own the routing and rollback runbook.
jamal: I'll own alert rule updates and dashboard panel additions.
alex: I'll own the retry release verification.
carlos: I'll keep customer comms and update ticket EXT-4567.
priya: thanks all. summary for postmortem: upstream provider latency surge -> gateway 5xx spike -> temporary cross-region routing + retry reduction -> alerts suppressed to prevent pager flood -> create provider-specific p95 alert + dashboard + update runbooks. please add any missing notes to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by priya. Incident state: mitigation in progress. added tag: upstream-outage-edgeX.
priya: closing pager for now, leaving incident as active. will schedule a 30-min debrief after outcomes stabilized.
sofia: posting runbook link and trace snippets to incident doc now.
jamal: once provider confirms, we'll revert routing split and rollback retries. log action items in postmortem (owner tags).
